Name: ATK_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the hitbox and damage parameters for attacks.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Radius
Fields.Description: Determines the radius of the hitbox (sphere/capsule).

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Radius
Fields.Description: Determines the radius of the hitbox (sphere/capsule).

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Radius
Fields.Description: Determines the radius of the hitbox (sphere/capsule).

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Radius
Fields.Description: Determines the radius of the hitbox (sphere/capsule).

Fields.Name: Knockback Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which the target is knocked back. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: Hit Stop Time
Fields.Description: Hit-stop length when this attack connects (hard hit). In seconds.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 0
Fields.Description: SpEffect ID applied to victim by this attack.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect ID applied to victim by this attack.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: SpEffect ID applied to victim by this attack.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 3
Fields.Description: SpEffect ID applied to victim by this attack.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 4
Fields.Description: SpEffect ID applied to victim by this attack.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID to place the sphere hitbox, or the tip of the capsule hitbox, for this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID to place the sphere hitbox, or the tip of the capsule hitbox, for this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID to place the sphere hitbox, or the tip of the capsule hitbox, for this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Initial Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID to place the sphere hitbox, or the tip of the capsule hitbox, for this hit.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID for the other end of the capsule hitbox. -1 makes this hit a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID for the other end of the capsule hitbox. -1 makes this hit a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID for the other end of the capsule hitbox. -1 makes this hit a sphere.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Secondary Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The dummy polygon ID for the other end of the capsule hitbox. -1 makes this hit a sphere.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Blow-off
Fields.Description: The multiplier to apply to the base blow-off value.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Kinetic
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the base kinetic attack power.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Energy
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the energy attack power.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Explosive
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the explosive attack power.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Coral
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the Coral attack power.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Stamina
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the stamina attack power.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Attack
Fields.Description: The multiplier to apply to the base guard attack value. Compared against the guard defense value to determine if the attack will bounce.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Guard Defense
Fields.Description: Player only. The multiplier to the base guard defense value. Compared against the guard attack value to determine if the attack will bounce.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Throw Escape
Fields.Description: Weapon correction applied to the throw escape attack value.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Poise
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the base poise attack value set on the weapon.

Fields.Name: Damage: Kinetic
Fields.Description: The base Kinetic attack value. Used primarily for NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Damage: Energy
Fields.Description: The base Energy attack value. Used primarily for NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Damage: Explosive
Fields.Description: The base Explosive attack value. Used primarily for NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Damage: Coral
Fields.Description: The base Coral attack value. Used primarily for NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Damage: Stamina
Fields.Description: The base stamina attack value.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Attack
Fields.Description: The base guard attack value. Compared against the guard defense value to determine if the attack will bounce.

Fields.Name: Damage: Guard Defense
Fields.Description: The base guard defense value. Compared against the guard attack value to determine if the attack will bounce.

Fields.Name: Damage: Poise
Fields.Description: The base poise attack value.

Fields.Name: Damage: Throw Escape
Fields.Description: The base throw escape attack value.

Fields.Name: Damage: Object Destruction
Fields.Description: The base object destruction value. Applied to the object's HP.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Correction: Stamina
Fields.Description: The multiplier to apply to the reduction of stamina damage when guarding. Positive values increase guard stability, negative values decrease it.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption
Fields.Description: Uniform correction to the guard performance set in the NPC or weapon params. 0: x1, 100: x2, -100: x0. Guard multiplier = value / 100 + 1.

Fields.Name: Throw Type ID
Fields.Description: The throw type ID to use with this attack against the victim.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the attack this hit represents.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the attack this hit represents.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the attack this hit represents.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which part of the attack this hit represents.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Priority
Fields.Description: Not usable at the code level. Intended as the priority when two or more hits connect at the same time: the higher priority hit is used.

Fields.Name: Hit 1: Priority
Fields.Description: Not usable at the code level. Intended as the priority when two or more hits connect at the same time: the higher priority hit is used.

Fields.Name: Hit 2: Priority
Fields.Description: Not usable at the code level. Intended as the priority when two or more hits connect at the same time: the higher priority hit is used.

Fields.Name: Hit 3: Priority
Fields.Description: Not usable at the code level. Intended as the priority when two or more hits connect at the same time: the higher priority hit is used.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Hostile
Fields.Description: The damage animation to apply to the victim of this attack.

Fields.Name: Map Hit Type
Fields.Description: Which map collision the attack hitboxes check against.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Invalidation
Fields.Description: Bypass rate for the target's guard cut rate, from -100 to 100. 0: normal, -100: guard cut fully ignored, 100: the target's guard effect is doubled. For example, -50 turns a 100% cut shield into a 50% cut.

Fields.Name: Kinetic Attribute
Fields.Description: Kinetic attribute applied to the attack.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Special attribute applied to the attack.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation Type
Fields.Description: Attack attribute used to pick the hit particle effect and sound. Particle effect and sound are chosen as one set by attribute, material and size.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: Attack material used to pick the hit particle effect and sound. Particle effect and sound are chosen as one set by attribute, material and size.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Size
Fields.Description: Attack size used to pick the hit particle effect and sound. Marked as reserved but still used: always set it to blank or Small.

Fields.Name: Defence Presentation: Sound
Fields.Description: Defence material used for the sound when this attack is guarded (slot 1).

Fields.Name: Hit Source Type
Fields.Description: The source of the dummy Polygon ID to use for this attack.

Fields.Name: Throw Flag
Fields.Description: Flag that sets the attack's throw behaviour.

Fields.Name: Ignore Guard
Fields.Description: If ON, then this attack ignores the victim's guard and applies the damage animation automatically.

Fields.Name: Disable Guard Drain
Fields.Description: If ON, the guard-break check from the stamina attack still happens, but no stamina is actually taken.

Fields.Name: Disable Hit SpEffect
Fields.Description: If ON, this attack applies no on-hit SpEffects to the target.

Fields.Name: Disable Missed Attack Notification
Fields.Description: If ON, then the enemy AI is not given notification of a missed attack.

Fields.Name: Repeat Hit Particles
Fields.Description: Enemy only. If ON, the hit particle effect plays repeatedly when the attack hits a wall.

Fields.Name: Is Arrow Attack
Fields.Description: Marks the attack as an arrow-type attack. Used in part damage checks.

Fields.Name: Is Ghost Attack
Fields.Description: Marks the attack as a ghost attack. Used in ghost damage checks.

Fields.Name: Ignore Invulnerability Frames
Fields.Description: If ON, then invulnerability frames (such as roll frames) are ignored by this attack. Complete invulnerability is NOT ignored however.

Fields.Name: Attack Particle Strength
Fields.Description: Attack strength used to pick the hit particle effect.

Fields.Name: Attack Particle Direction
Fields.Description: Attack direction used to pick the hit particle effect.

Fields.Name: Hide Hit Display on HUD
Fields.Description: If ON, the HUD shows no Hit or Guard display when this attack hits; only its SpEffects are applied.

Fields.Name: Disable Additive Replacement on Repeated Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, disables the feature that replaces the damage with additive damage when the target takes repeated damage.

Fields.Name: Damage Reaction Cancels Inertia
Fields.Description: If ON, the damage reaction removes the target's inertia.

Fields.Name: Perform Occlusion Checks
Fields.Description: If ON, checks whether the target can be attacked through an obstruction before the hit lands.

Fields.Name: Special Stagger Type
Fields.Description: Behavior identification value: Causes a specific enemy to have a special reaction when hit by a specific attack.

Fields.Name: Attack Sound Strength
Fields.Description: Attack strength used to pick the hit sound.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Impulse
Fields.Description: Impulse applied to a rigid body hit by the attack.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [1]
Fields.Description: Decal applied directly on hit (slot 1).

Fields.Name: Decal ID [2]
Fields.Description: Decal applied directly on hit (slot 2).

Fields.Name: Invoked AI Sound upon Attack
Fields.Description: ID of AI sound generated when an attack occurs

Fields.Name: Invoked AI Sound upon Hit
Fields.Description: ID of AI sound generated at the time of hit

Fields.Name: Vibration on Hit
Fields.Description: Vibration ID on hit (-1 disabled). This is the vibration ID when none of the following three apply.

Fields.Name: Vibration on Hit: Tip
Fields.Description: Hit vibration ID used when the hit lands with the tip. -1: disabled.

Fields.Name: Vibration on Hit: Middle
Fields.Description: Hit vibration ID used when the hit lands with the middle. -1: disabled.

Fields.Name: Vibration on Hit: Root
Fields.Description: Hit vibration ID used when the hit lands with the root. -1: disabled.

Fields.Name: Defence Presentation: Particles
Fields.Description: The particles used when guarding.

Fields.Name: Defence Presentation: Sound 2
Fields.Description: Defence material used for the sound when this attack is guarded (slot 2).

Fields.Name: Defence Presentation: Particles 2
Fields.Description: Defence material used for the particle effect when this attack is guarded (slot 2).

Fields.Name: Can Break Poise
Fields.Description: If ON, this attack can break the target's poise (super armour).

Fields.Name: Asset Destruction: TAE Action Type
Fields.Description: TAE action type played when an asset is destroyed by this attack

Fields.Name: Camera Vibration on Hit
Fields.Description: Camera vibration played when this attack hits the player.

Fields.Name: Camera Vibration on Guarded Hit
Fields.Description: Camera vibration played when this attack hits a guarding player.

Fields.Name: Multi-Hit Interval
Fields.Description: Interval at which the target can take damage from this attack again. In seconds. 0 or less: hits only once.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Attacker Speed Correction - Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Attacker speed at which Minimum Speed Multiplier applies when adding the attacker's speed to the knockback. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Attacker Speed Correction - Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Attacker speed at which Maximum Speed Multiplier applies when adding the attacker's speed to the knockback. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Attacker Speed Correction - Minimum Speed Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier for adding the attacker's speed to the knockback, used at or below the minimum speed.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Attacker Speed Correction - Maximum Speed Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier for adding the attacker's speed to the knockback, used at or above the maximum speed.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Recoil when Shooting
Fields.Description: Recoil (knockback) speed received when shooting. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: Behavior on Hit: Hostile
Fields.Description: How this attack hits hostile targets.

Fields.Name: Behavior on Hit: Friendly
Fields.Description: How this attack hits friendly targets.

Fields.Name: Behavior on Hit: Self
Fields.Description: How this attack hits the attacker itself.

Fields.Name: Death Animation Type
Fields.Description: Determines the opponent's animation when the opponent dies from this attack.

Fields.Name: Camera Vibration ID on Map Collision
Fields.Description: ID of camera vibration when hitting the map

Fields.Name: Map Collision Camera Vibration Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which camera vibration is effective when hitting the map. In metres.

Fields.Name: Recoil Direction Type
Fields.Description: Direction that serves as a basis for calculating recoil knockback

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Friendly
Fields.Description: Damage level used when the attack hits an ally, including the attacker itself.

Fields.Name: Attack Correction: Dark
Fields.Description: Player only. Multiplier applied to the dark attack power.

Fields.Name: Grab Type
Fields.Description: Flag used for grab information

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Start Grab
Fields.Description: The target can be grabbed when the damage level is this value or higher.

Fields.Name: Grab Attachment Correction
Fields.Description: How the attachment direction is corrected when grabbing.

Fields.Name: Guard Judgment Type
Fields.Description: Attack position type used when checking guards and barriers.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Initial Length
Fields.Description: Starting length of the hit capsule, in metres.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Max Length
Fields.Description: Maximum length of the hit capsule, in metres.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Length Expansion Time
Fields.Description: Time over which the hit's length extends towards the secondary dummy poly. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Max Radius
Fields.Description: Maximum radius of the hit capsule, in metres.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Radius Expansion Time
Fields.Description: Time over which the hit's thickness grows linearly from the radius to the maximum radius. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Expansion Delay
Fields.Description: Time the hit keeps its initial shape before it starts to change. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Particle ID
Fields.Description: The particle effect used by this hit capsule. -1: disabled.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Particle Delete Type
Fields.Description: The deletion type for the SFX used by this hit capsule.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Generation Type
Fields.Description: The creation type used by this hit capsule.

Fields.Name: Can Hit FPS Barrier
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack hits FPS barriers.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Can Penetrate Character
Fields.Description: If ON, hit 0 passes through characters while it expands or contracts.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Can Penetrate Map
Fields.Description: If ON, hit 0 passes through map collision while it expands or contracts.

Fields.Name: Hit 0: Place Particle on Hit Location
Fields.Description: If ON, the particle effect during expansion or contraction is placed from the tip of hit 0 instead of its root.

Fields.Name: Use Additional Knockback Power for Blade
Fields.Description: If ON, uses Knockback: Additional Power for Blade for this attack's additive damage knockback.

Fields.Name: Correct Hit Particle Position of Melee Weapon
Fields.Description: If ON, the hit particle effect is moved to a position between the lock dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Correct Hit Particle Direction to Bullet Direction
Fields.Description: If ON, the hit particle effect is aligned with the bullet's flight direction.

Fields.Name: Enable Weight-Based Attack Multiplier
Fields.Description: Player only. If ON, the attack power multiplier from the correction graph param's total weight correction coefficient is applied.

Fields.Name: Ignore Hit on Attached Assets
Fields.Description: If ON, hit 0 does not hit assets attached to characters while it expands or contracts. Used to improve performance.

Fields.Name: Ignore Hit after First Hit
Fields.Description: If ON, a character or asset is not checked again once it has been hit, to improve performance. The particle effect position may shift. Unlike multi-hit exclusion, which excludes after a hit, this excludes before the hit.

Fields.Name: Use FSDP
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack is sent with FSDP: delivery is guaranteed, but packet loss causes stalls.

Fields.Name: Is Immortality Ignored
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack ignores immortality SpEffects such as emergency Pulse Armor.

Fields.Name: Ignore Multi-Hits on Map Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, hits on the map are not counted towards the multi-hit count.

Fields.Name: Is Assault Boost Bonus Attack
Fields.Description: Marks this attack as an Assault Boost bonus attack.

Fields.Name: Ignore Defense Particles on Impact
Fields.Description: If ON, disables the change of the impacted side's defence material used for particle effects.

Fields.Name: Share Multi-Hit Info Across Generations
Fields.Description: If ON, attacks with the same attack ID share multi-hit information, ignoring bullet generations.

Fields.Name: AI Detection: Engagement Level Increase
Fields.Description: Amount the engagement level rises each time the target is hit.

Fields.Name: Knockback Start Direction Type
Fields.Description: Knockback direction determination type

Fields.Name: Firing Sound Category
Fields.Description: Category used with the attack material and attack strength to pick the sound to play.

Fields.Name: Sound ID
Fields.Description: ID used to pick the sound to play.

Fields.Name: Sound Reverb Level
Fields.Description: Reverb level of the sound.

Fields.Name: HD Vibration Slot Index
Fields.Description: HD pad vibration playback slot (0-3)

Fields.Name: Damage Judgment Type
